মেডিক্যাল পার্টের পরীক্ষা – ২ 
Medicine-02 
1. Endocrine and Metabolic Diseases Diabetes mellitus Thyrotoxicosis Hypothyroidism and iodine deficiency state Cushing’s syndrome and Addison’s disease. 2. Connective Tissue Disorder Rheumatoid arthritis and reactive arthritis Degenerative joint diseases including cervical spondylosis Gout 3. Diseases of the Blood Anaemia: iron deficiency Common haemolytic anaemia (Thalassemia and acquired haemolytic anaemia) Common bleeding disorders (Thrombocytopenia and haemophilia) Agranulocytosis and aplastic anaemia Leukaemias: Acute and chronic Lymphomas Multiple myelomas Blood transfusion 5. Nephrology & Urinary System Nephritic & Nephrotic Illness UTI / Pyelonephritis ARF (Acute Renal Failure) CRF (Chronic Renal Failure)

মেডিক্যাল পার্টের পরীক্ষা – ৩ 
Medicine-03 
6. Diseases due to infections: Approach to infectious diseases — diagnostic and therapeutic principles General principles and rational use of antibiotics Dengue Enteric fever Amoebiasis, Giardiasis Kala-azar Malaria Filariasis Rabies Tuberculosis HIV/AIDS Leprosy Cholera, Diarrheal disease Sexually Transmitted Diseases (STD) Gonorrhoea Syphilis Nongonococcal urethritis Neurological System · Cerebrovascular diseases · Meningitis: viral, bacterial and tuberculosis · Encephalitis, viral · Peripheral neuropathy

মেডিক্যাল পার্টের পরীক্ষা – ৫ Medicine-05 1. Medical Psychiatry · Anxiety neurosis · Depression · Dissociative disorder · Somatoform disorder, etc. 2. Nutritional, Metabolic and Environmental diseases: Protein energy malnutrition, Obesity, Diseases due to vitamin deficiency and excess 3. Geriatric Medicine · Common Genetic Disorders · General principles of treating elderly · Health problems of the elderly 4. Water and Electrolytes and Acid-base Homeostasis · Diagnosis and treatment of specific fluid and electrolytic disorders 5. Common Immunologic Disorders 6. Helminthic diseases: · Nematodes · Trematodes 7. Terminal Care 8. Communication Skill

ডেন্টাল পার্টের পরীক্ষা – ৫
 Oral Surgery Part 03
 (Surgical aspects of the oral tumours-Tumours of the hard tissues of the cavity, odontogenic tumours, osteogenic tumours, pregnancy tumours, tumours of the soft tissues of the oral cavity, carcinoma of the oral cavity, diagnosis and treatment.
 The temporomandibular joints-Anatomy, painful temporomandibular joint, aetiology symptoms, clinical findings, roentgen graphic findings and treatment of T.M.J. dislocation, Ankylosis with complications.

ডেন্টাল পার্টের পরীক্ষা – ৯
Science of Dental Materials Part-02 
Toxic and side effects of the materials and protective measures to be taken. Manipulation of the materials, its clinical and laboratory uses. Variables that affect the properties of the final products of the materials. Tarnish and corrosion and the preventive measures of the metallic made prostheses and restoratives used in the oral cavity.

মেডিক্যাল পার্টের পরীক্ষা – ২০ Physiology-2 1. Kidney and body fluid: i. Mechanism of urine formation and concentration ii. Renal circulation iii. Renal function tests iv. Regulation of body fluids 2. Endocrinology and reproduction: i. Hypothesis ii. Thyroid iii. Parathyroid iv. Pancreas v. Adrenal gland vi. Ovary and testis vii. Reproduction and control of fertility in the male and female 3. Nervous system: i. General organization of nervous system ii. Reflexes iii. Cerebellum iv. Hypothalamus v. Emotion 4. Special senses: i. Visual pathway ii. Light reflex iii. Accommodation reaction iv. Vestibular apparatus v. Pathway for test and audition

মেডিক্যাল পার্টের পরীক্ষা – ২৭ Pharmacology a) Formulation, absorption, distribution, biotransformation, elimination and adverse effects of drugs b) Mechanism of action of drugs (pharmacodynamics) c) Half-life, steady state concentration of drugs d) Indication, contraindication, and adverse effects of common drugs Rational use of drugs
